# Kollaborate webhook

Ubuntu server

```sh
sudo apt install -y nginx
sudo apt install -y php8.3-fpm php8.3-mbstring php8.3-curl
sudo snap install --classic certbot
```

```sh
# Recommended to do this under /var/www
git clone https://github.com/tsukomu/kollaborate-webhook.git webhook
```

You must put environment.php at the root of this repo:

```php
<?php

// Public-facing webhook url
$public_webhook = "";

// Private logging webhook url
$logging_webhook = "";

// Secret key generated by Kollaborate
$secret_key = "";

// Logging settings

// If true, will log to the specified file, otherwise will log to standard error_log.
// This should only be true when debugging, as it's insecure to let people write literally anything on your server.
// When debugging, remember that actually fatal errors will be logged to stderr (eg. /var/log/nginx/error.log)
$log_to_file = false;
// File to log to.
$log_file = "/tmp/webhook.log";
// Logging level. Currently there are two levels ERROR (0) and INFO(1)
// Set to 1 to log information (and errors)
// Set to 0 to only log errors
// Set to -1 to log nothing
$log_level = 1;

// The links posted at the bottom of every public webhook message
function linkList($event)
{
    return implode(" **|** ", array(
        hyperlink("Link 1", "https://example.com"),
        hyperlink("Link 2", "https://example.com"),
        hyperlink("Link 3", "https://example.com"),
    ));
}
```

# Nginx configuration

/etc/nginx/conf.d/webhook.conf, stolen from Grav lol

```conf
## Begin - Server Info
listen 80;
root /var/www/webhook/public;
server_name your.domain.com;
## End - Server Info

## Begin - Index
location / {
    try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$query_string;
}
## End - Index

## Begin - Security
location ~* /(\.git|cache|bin|logs|backup|tests)/.*$ { return 403; }
location ~* /(system|vendor)/.*\.(txt|xml|md|html|htm|shtml|shtm|json|yaml|yml|php|php2|php3|php4|php5|phar|phtml|pl|py|cgi|twig|sh|bat)$ { return 403; }
location ~* /user/.*\.(txt|md|json|yaml|yml|php|php2|php3|php4|php5|phar|phtml|pl|py|cgi|twig|sh|bat)$ { return 403; }
location ~ /(LICENSE\.txt|composer\.lock|composer\.json|nginx\.conf|web\.config|htaccess\.txt|\.htaccess) { return 403; }
## End - Security

## Begin - PHP
location ~ \.php$ {
    fastcgi_pass unix:/var/run/php/php-fpm.sock;
    fastcgi_split_path_info ^(.+\.php)(/.+)$;
    fastcgi_index index.php;
    include fastcgi_params;
    fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME $document_root/$fastcgi_script_name;
}
## End - PHP
```

Use certbot to enable https:

```sh
certbot --nginx -d your.domain.com
```

Certbot will change the Nginx configuration, this is fine.
